name: Magnesium glycinate

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: Magnesium chelated to glycine, a form chosen for absorption and low osmotic laxative effect relative to magnesium oxide or citrate. Magnesium is a cofactor for several hundred enzymatic reactions.

systems.note: Repletion of an enzymatic cofactor; the intended effect.
Renally cleared; accumulates to hypermagnesaemia in renal impairment.

monitors.why: Tracks body stores more closely than the serum value, which is tightly regulated.
The commonly available assay, though a poor index of total body stores.
Accumulation in renal impairment is the specific concern.
